notes.title: Vorax is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.content:
Attention, Mercenaries, 

the moment you've been waiting for is here.

Vorax is [b]AVAILABLE NOW[/b] in Early access and is 10% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/

[previewyoutube=B8nhhzQQPH0;full][/previewyoutube]

Early Access release marks an important milestone in a journey that has spanned over two years and half, filled with dedication and hard work.
Creating Vorax has been a labor of love and commitment. We have faced numerous challenges and obstacles. We've had intense development cycles and had to overcome various technical issues or limitations. Not to mention a big reshuffle in the team that took place last year due to that we decided to rewrote all core game code from scratch.  
Throughout it all, our motivation has been to deliver a game that meets the high standards we set for ourselves and that our community expects. However this is only the first step.

[h2]Delay :[/h2]
We want to apologize and address the delay in our initial launch plans. This decision was not made lightly. Our guiding principle has always been to prioritize quality over profits. We believe in taking the time to do things right, even if it means making difficult decisions along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/c0afa52250c53e1d3c24d12571983ca72de574db.png[/img]

We received valuable feedback from Valve and several trustworthy community members and content creators. Their insights highlighted areas where Vorax could benefit from additional polish. While we felt the game was ready for Early Access release, we recognized the importance of making a strong first impression. An Early Access launch on Steam is a significant event, and we want to ensure that Vorax is as polished as possible for this crucial moment.

We took the occasion to introduce at last second two much requested features like:

[list]
[*] headbob removal ( now it is disabled by default )
[*] multiple shotgun shells 
[/list]

and we are working to re-introduce our 'vintage' orange HUD in a couple of days this week.

 Our goal is to exceed your expectations and deliver a game that truly stands out in the survival horror genre.

[h2]Current Status and Future Plans:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/f3d88c4648b65914929c04863097b4a1a5190004.jpg[/img]

The Early Access launch of Vorax is just the beginning. The game has already a lot of content , but with your help with will grow even more. We are committed to continuously improving and enhancing the game based on your feedback. Our roadmap includes regular updates, new content, and ongoing refinements to ensure that Vorax evolves and improves over time.

Over the next few months, we have several key updates planned to expand and enrich your experience with Vorax, just to remind you a few key locations: The School, Electric Central, Sanctuary, Olive Factory and more. New Weapons, New Features and Improvements, expect various enhancements and optimizations to improve gameplay and performance.


[h3]Closing reminder:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/51947278bece47ba2d3d1194a51277d66a93d75a.jpg[/img]

Engage with the new content as it becomes available, thoroughly test all features, and report any issues encountered.

Your feedback is crucial to refining these updates and ensuring the best possible experience.

We encourage you to [url=https://vorax.indiegala.com/]order Vorax from our website located here[/url] if you'd like to support us. 

If you haven't already, please make sure to [b]wishlist [/b]and follow Vorax on Steam here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/

If you have any feedback or any questions, you may get in touch with us by joining our Discord. Your constant support is what helps us make this game great:

[url=https://discord.gg/bXnMMb3Yrc][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3402923/5bb2433aad01fce79766323ac1cd5fb9c55d7a59.png[/img][/url]

Thank you for your unwavering support and commitment.

The Vorax Development Team

For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on [b]PS5[/b], your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.

Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

[b]Secondly[/b], we have not forgotten about our PC fans. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Die Young[/url] just got updated on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Steam[/url]. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

notes.title: Die Young: Prologue is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Play Die Young: Prologue now![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/973000/Die_Young_Prologue/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/973000/Die_Young_Prologue/][img]https://i.imgur.com/sWFXqKK.jpg[/img][/url]

Get ready to slowly merge into Die Young's full story starting right from the roots! 

Play as Nehir, a field agent of a well-known political party trying to deconstruct and eliminate Brother n.1, the leader of Island's community. 

The Prologue covers her desperate attempt to reach the rendezvous point. Will she be able to save herself or will she die young?


Die Young: Prologue is an action-adventure with a more linear structure than the open-world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Die Young[/url], but it leaves the player with the possibility of using different approaches and paths to escape.
The game consists of three levels: Introductory, Main, Final. 
If players choose to explore these levels, they'll discover several useful items that'll unravel the deep lore behind Die Young.

We hope you enjoy this free prequel game!

notes.title: Update 0.96 is out!
notes.content:
Update 0.96 is out!
Thanks to all users for helping us with their feedbacks!

"The Mall" (Deathmatch)
[img]http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/41972545101726218/70C81DCF864CC5B777CAF1ECF84F5C566AFBF54E/[/img]

"Ruins" (Deathmatch, Team deathmatch)
[img]http://cloud-4.steampowered.com/ugc/41972545101722256/2969E349AACA021F20305BBCE3477282A6EA55D2/[/img]

- [Maps] Map "The Mall" added (Deathmatch)
- [Maps] Map "Ruins" added (Deathmatch, Team deathmatch)
- [Maps] At the end of the match, on dedicated servers users could vote the next map using F1, F2, F3, ... keys
(map playlists on user-hosted servers will come in future updates)

- [General] Upgraded codebase to Unity3D 4.5.1
- [General] Now mature content should be reported as "mature" (the checkbox should be activated inside the informations panel of the asset)
- [General] It's possible to show/hide all custom characters reported as mature (by default, hide all mature content)
- [General] It's possible to choose to show/hide each single custom character despite the mature property
- [General] The player that hosts a match could kick griefers
- [General] When a player kills his own team mates 2 times or more, he will raise a vote kick against him
- [General] Players could report to server that another player is offensive or hasn't reported his character as "mature".
Each custom character used by an offensive player will be considered as mature, also his chat will be disabled on that server.
- [General] Far terrain/characters are shown/hidden chunk by chunk

- [GUI] A new panel was added to see characters that are currently used by players
- [GUI] Now it's possible to chat also when the game is over

- [Editor] It's possible to lock use/modify for custom characters and maps
- [Editor] It's possible to know the resistance of blocks from tooltips inside the blockset panel
- [Editor] Menu buttons now have tooltips

- [Weapons] Aim is slightly more precise and less smooth
- [Weapons] Improved Shotgun
- [Weapons] Sniper delay before reload was removed
- [Weapons] Sniper kills with one-shot on the whole body
- [Weapons] Better lag management for bullets

- [Fix] Fixed some freeze problems on Linux
- [Fix] Fixed author field for custom characters
- [Fix] Fixed the collider of the claymore
- [Fix] Fixed fog on linux
- [Fix] Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update 0.95 is out!
notes.content:
The following changes are all based on the suggestions made by the AWESOME community of Blockstorm in [url=http://forums.playblockstorm.com/index.php]official forums[/url] and Steam forums!

[list]
[*] [Maps] Deathmatch map "Medieval Hell" added
[img]http://s13.postimg.org/yi6d1ejwn/medhellprev.png[/img]
[*] [Maps] Assault map "Outpost Attack" added
[img]http://s10.postimg.org/76x8z25dl/outpostpreview.png[/img]
[*] [Maps] "Bridge Pass" has an indestructible layer under the helipad
[*] [Maps] "Bridge Pass" is also available in the official Team Deathmatch servers

[*] [Gameplay] Kill assists now have a proper score (not yet counted in statistics, but we'll add them soon)
[*] [Gameplay] Death by falling over is no more considered as suicide if there's a cause like an explosion, a falling structure or a burst of bullets. On the countrary, the kill score is assigned to the causing player(s).
[*] [Gameplay] Explosions propagates to near explosives

[*] [GUI] Chat and events are split in two logs for better readability
[*] [GUI] "Tab" key let you see also older chat messages and events

[*] [Weapons] The reload time of the Shotgun/Shorty depends on the number of shells to be charged.
[*] [Weapons] Sniper inertia effect is slightly lowered
[*] [Weapons] The Rocket launcher now has a delay between shoot and the actual rocket launch to avoid overuse in short distances.
[*] [Weapons] Shotgun hitten graphics (the red arc) was reversed, now it's fixed
[*] [Weapons] AK47, Handgun, M240 precision was slightly modified

[*] [Audio] Fixed some bugs on weapon recharge
[*] [Performance] Faster load time for characters
[*] [Performance] Better lag management

[*] [Fix] Fixed a problem when falling into lava
[*] [Fix] Fixed a speed issue when jumping and aiming
[*] [Fix] Fixed some problems when placing explosives
[*] [Fix] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
